mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password_hash, role, enabled, auth_version, created_at FROM user_accounts WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, username, password_hash, role, enabled, auth_version, created_at FROM user_accounts WHERE lower(username) = lower(#{username})
SELECT id, username, password_hash, role, enabled, auth_version, created_at FROM user_accounts ORDER BY created_at, id
SELECT count(*) FROM user_accounts WHERE enabled AND role = 'ADMIN'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_accounts(id, username, password_hash, role, enabled, auth_version) VALUES (#{account.id,typeHandler=com.aiworkbench.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{account.username}, #{account.passwordHash}, #{account.role}, #{account.enabled}, #{account.authVersion})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_accounts SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, auth_version = auth_version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_accounts SET role = #{role}, auth_version = auth_version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_accounts SET enabled = #{enabled}, auth_version = auth_version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
